provenance: AST census of os.getenv/os.environ.get literal keys across src/fanops, plus os.environ[...] assignment targets.
read_sites: see derived/configuration.json — generated by tools.arch regen

precedence_model.runtime_owner: Config, EXCLUSIVELY. Every Config property is an os.getenv() evaluated PER ACCESS (uncached). There is no runtime handoff to Settings (INV-05). Config is the live getenv façade; Settings is doctor / fanops config strict evaluation of the same declarations.
precedence_model.Settings_role: Doctor-only strict validator + docs introspection. It NEVER feeds Config. Runtime is lenient (warn+fallback); doctor is strict (raise). The split is intentional, not drift.

propagation.daemon: re-reads .env with override=True AND rebuilds Config EVERY TICK (cli.py:1303-1304). A go_live write reaches the daemon within one tick.
propagation.studio: load_dotenv ONCE at process entry (cli.py:795), then blocks in app.run. A .env change made by the CLI or daemon NEVER reaches a running Studio (COUP-02b).
propagation.secrets: keyring-first. Reads fail OPEN; writes fail CLOSED (set_secret round-trips the value back and raises OSError if it does not persist — load-bearing, because the caller then scrubs the .env fallback).

writers.FANOPS_LIVE: golive._dual_write ONLY (INV-18, AST-confirmed: exactly 2 os.environ[...] assignment sites in src/ — golive.py:66 (dynamic key) and autopilot.py:80 (FANOPS_RESPONDER)).
